dateAssessment: The working calendar uses YAML’s year 1749 and the spoken August 10 opening. Two completed overnight rests independently support August 11 and 12; the time extraction therefore matches the August 10–12 YAML span. Watch labels are approximate. The final dawn sequence is called both “morning” and “pre-dawn”; the explicit pre-dawn arrival and the ship’s connection to the scouts’ return keep that sequence together. The next-session eight-round preparation window is a granted opportunity, not an additional elapsed interval here.

watches.summary: Three Wells return explicitly dated August 10, about 6 p.m.
Completed overnight ends at dawn; eight-hour rest convention places its start in the preceding dusk.
Seeker’s twelve-hour casting starts at dawn and finishes just after 4 p.m.
By noon the camp has emptied and Vindristjarna is visible on the horizon.
The party boards Vindristjarna and departs just after 4 p.m.
Sunset during flight; escarpment about 9 p.m.; camp about 9:15 p.m.; worm slows within roughly ten minutes.
After camp planning, another completed eight-hour overnight ends in pre-dawn light.
Scouts return pre-dawn; ship arrives around then. A minute’s Sight and further waiting precede the still-pre-dawn grove arrival.
